title: Unisex National Park – Running Late. Bison Traffic. Embroidered Zip Hoodie

seo.title: National Park Zip Up Hoodie – Running Late. Bison Traffic.
seo.description: A national park zip up hoodie: RUNNING LATE. BISON TRAFFIC. on the back over a bison blocking a mountain road, plus stitched BISON TRAFFIC. lettering on the chest.

descriptionHtml:
The Story

This national park zip up hoodie is for the road tripper whose arrival time is now up to a bison, zipped on for the overlook and the slow drive out of the park.

A brown bison stands on a mountain road ahead of a vintage car with luggage on its roof, between pine trees and a splattered sky, in rust, teal, cream and navy with a worn print texture. RUNNING LATE. runs above it in two lines and BISON TRAFFIC. below in heavy slab capitals, the last line wider than the first: rust and cream on Black and Navy, brick red and navy on Ash. The full print is on the back. On the front, a small BISON over TRAFFIC. wordmark in the same slab capitals as the back is embroidered on the left chest, and the word LATE is stitched on the left cuff, in white thread on Black and Navy and navy thread on Ash. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed and stitched the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Regular fit zip-up hoodie with a metal zipper
  • 50% cotton, 50% polyester fleece, soft inside and outside
  • Fabric weight: 8 oz/yd²
  • Embroidered left-chest BISON TRAFFIC. wordmark and left-cuff LATE, printed back
  • Front pouch pockets and an unlined hood with color-matched drawcord
  • Double-needle stitching at shoulders, armholes, neck, waistband and cuffs
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • 3 colors: Black, Navy and Ash
  • Blank product sourced from Honduras and El Salvador

Questions

How does the Running Late. Bison Traffic. zip hoodie fit?
The Running Late. Bison Traffic. national park zip up hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. is a regular unisex fit in sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for an easy layer over a tee, or go up one for a roomier fit. The first size exchange within 30 days is free.

Is this national park hoodie warm enough for cool mountain overlooks?
It is a mid-weight layer. The Graphic Tees Co. zip hoodie is a Gildan 18600 in 8 oz fleece, 50% cotton and 50% polyester, soft inside and outside, with a metal zipper, front pouch pockets and an unlined hood. It handles cool mountain overlooks, campfire evenings and the long drive out of the park well.

Where are the print and the embroidery on this zip hoodie?
The full design, RUNNING LATE. above the road scene and BISON TRAFFIC. below, is printed across the back so the zipper never splits it. On the front, a small BISON over TRAFFIC. wordmark in the same slab capitals as the back sits on the left chest, and LATE is stitched on the left cuff.

How do I care for the embroidery on this hoodie?
Zip the Graphic Tees Co. hoodie, turn it inside out and wash cold with similar colors, then tumble dry on low or hang dry. Skip bleach and do not iron over the stitching. The BISON TRAFFIC. wordmark on the chest and the LATE cuff are stitched thread, which keeps its shape wash after wash with gentle care.

Is it a good gift for a national park lover, and when should I order for Christmas?
Yes, for the friend who plans every trip around the parks and still arrives late. Graphic Tees Co. makes each embroidered hoodie to order, so for Christmas order by about December 8. Orders over $45 ship free in the US, and one free size exchange within 30 days covers a wrong guess on size.
